BOUNDLESS.Title: Boundless, Seamless World
BOUNDLESS.StatusLoaded: Seamless GPU renderer and spatial chunk streamer active.

Config.EnabledHint: Enables the Quadtree pyramid, GPU lighting batch, and spatial world streaming.
Config.LevelEnabledHint: Attaches a dedicated manifest or baked virtual tiles, walls, lights, and sounds to this level.
Config.ManifestUrlHint: URL to the pyramid and sector JSON manifest (defaults to the built-in 1000×1000 map).
Config.PyramidBaseUrlHint: Optional. Leave blank if this level only uses streamed tiles without a background pyramid.
Config.MaxLosPxHint: Caps token line-of-sight raycast radius (default 4500 px = 225 ft).
Config.ChunkedFogHint: High-resolution 50×50-cell chunked exploration memory bypassing Foundry's 4096 px limit. Follows the scene's native fog mode (Disabled, Individual, Shared) from the Visibility tab.
Config.ShowPoisHint: Displays categorized clickable location pins with automatic anti-overlap decluttering on macro zoom-out.
Config.ShowCharacterPinsHint: Displays your assigned character's portrait on the map when zoomed out and a sticky edge pointer when off-screen for one-click close focus.
Config.VirtualizeTokensHint: Draws native non-player token placeables strictly inside each client's viewport with a per-frame budget and LRU-unmounts distant PIXI objects without modifying scene documents.
Config.PoiJournalNoAccess: You do not have permission to view this journal.
Config.ResetFogDone: Chunked Fog of War cleared for the current level.
Config.BakeConfirmBody: Bake tiles, walls, lights, and ambient sounds on level "{level}" into Boundless spatial streaming?
Config.BakeRemoveOriginals: Remove original documents from the scene after baking
Config.BakeDone: Level "{level}" baked: {tiles} tiles, {walls} walls, {lights} lights, {sounds} sounds.

BOUNDLESS.PoiToolHint: Pin Mode. Left-click map to create, drag pin to move, Right-click for menu, Esc to exit.
BOUNDLESS.FogBrushHint: Fog Brush. Left-click to reveal, Shift + Left-click to hide, Alt + Wheel to resize, Esc to exit.

Settings.VramProfileHint: Texture cache limit for Boundless on this device. Auto adjusts based on your hardware.
Settings.VramLow: Low (512 MB, laptops and integrated GPU)

Perf.EnabledHint: Enables zero-config GPU, CPU, perception, and VRAM optimizations across all Foundry scenes.
Perf.TokenUiHint: Batches token bars, status effects, and nameplates and caches UI textures for higher FPS in token-heavy encounters.
Perf.WallsAndIcons: Sprite Rendering for Walls and Control Icons
Perf.WallsAndIconsHint: Replaces heavy vector drawing for wall segments and note, light, and sound control icons with a shared sprite atlas.
Perf.LightShadersHint: Replaces expensive procedural noise loops in animated light shaders with a precomputed lookup texture.
Perf.LightingScaleHint: Scales internal resolution of soft illumination and darkness passes to reduce GPU load with minimal visual impact.
Perf.CpuPerceptionHint: Accelerates visibility sweeps, fog commits, occlusion updates, token dragging, marquee selection, and text enrichment.
Perf.AutoScene: Standard Scene Auto-Culling and VRAM Cleanup
Perf.AutoSceneHint: Skips rendering offscreen objects on dense standard scenes, frees stale scene VRAM, and pre-warms sibling levels while idle.
Perf.DisableUiBlurHint: Disables backdrop-filter blur on interface windows and panels to help low-end GPUs and laptops.
Perf.IdleFpsLimitHint: Drops ticker frame rate to 20 FPS after 6 seconds of inactivity to reduce heat and battery drain.
Perf.HeavySceneHint: Scene "{scene}" is quite heavy. Right-click it in the Scenes directory and choose "Optimize with Boundless" for maximum smoothness.

Optimize.DialogBody: Scene "{scene}" will be automatically optimized for fast loading and smooth performance at any zoom level.
Optimize.CreateCopy: Create an optimized copy of the scene
Optimize.CreateCopyHint: Keeps the original scene untouched and opens the optimized copy automatically once finished.

BakeEdits.DialogBody: All virtual wall, light, sound, and tile edits on scene "{scene}" will be merged into a clean manifest file and temporary scene flags cleared.
BakeEdits.AbsorbNativeHint: Move newly added native walls, lights, sounds, and tiles into the manifest and remove their duplicates from the scene.
BakeEdits.Done: Edits on "{scene}" baked into manifest ({walls} walls, {lights} lights, {sounds} sounds, {tiles} tiles).
BakeEdits.Failed: Failed to bake edits into manifest. {error}

Unbake.DialogBody: Virtual walls, doors, lights, sounds, and tiles on scene "{scene}" will be restored as standard native Foundry documents.
Unbake.CreateCopy: Create an unbaked copy of the scene
Unbake.CreateCopyHint: Keeps the original Boundless scene untouched and opens the native copy automatically once finished.
Unbake.RestoreImagesHint: Stitches pyramid tiles back into a single WebP image whenever the original background was cleared.
Unbake.Done: Scene "{scene}" unbaked ({walls} walls, {lights} lights, {sounds} sounds, {tiles} tiles).

Selection.ViewportSelected: Selected objects in view ({selected} of {total}). Press Ctrl+A again to select all on this level.
Selection.ViewportEmpty: No objects in view. Press Ctrl+A again to select all on this level ({total}).
Selection.LevelSelected: Selected all objects on this level ({selected}).
Selection.LevelCapped: Selected the nearest {selected} of {total} objects on this level to preserve performance.
Selection.ZoomInVirtualLayer: Zoomed out too far to select virtual objects on this layer. Zoom closer to the target area.
